title: Austin's New City Manager: Nicholas Meiszer
summary:
*   Austin officials unanimously appointed Nicholas Meiszer as the city's new City Manager.
*   The selection occurred during a special, emergency meeting after a closed-door executive session.
*   Meiszer is set to begin his role on November 30, with an annual salary of $69,500.
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Emergency Special Called Council Meeting
October 31, 1981
4:00 Ρ.Μ.
Council Chambers
301 West Second Street
The meeting was called to order with Mayor McClellan presiding. Roll Call: Present: Mayor
McClellan, Mayor Pro Tem Trevino, Councilmembers
Deuser, Duncan, Urdy, Mullen, Goodman
Absent: None
Mayor McClellan announced that Council will convene in a closed or executive session
authorized by Section 2, Paragraph (g) of Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes
Annotated, for the purpose of selecting a City Manager; and after such closed or executive
session, any final action, decision or vote with regard to any matter considered in the
closed or executive session will be made in open session, should such action, decision or
vote be necessary.
Mayor McClellan announced that the Council would go into executive session at this time to
consider the items authorized in Section 2, Paragraph (g) of Article 6252-17, Texas
Revised Civil Statutes Annotated. October 31, 1981
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
RECESS
Council recessed its meeting for the Executive Session at 4:11 p.m. and resumed its
recessed meeting at 5:00 p.m. CITY MANAGER NAMED Mayor McClellan announced it is the
unanimous decision of the Council to appoint Mr. Nicholas Meiszer as City Manager,
effective November 30, 1981. His salary will be $69,500 annually. Motion Councilmember
Duncan moved that the Council approve the appointment of Mr. Nicholas Meiszer City
Manager, effective November 30, 1981 at an annual salary of $69,500. The motion, seconded
by Mayor Pro Tem Trevino, carried by the following vote: Ayes: Mayor McClellan, Mayor Pro
Tem Trevino, Councilmembers Deuser, Duncan, Goodman, Mullen, Urdy
Noes: None
ADJOURNMENT
Council adjourned its meeting at 5:02 p.m. APPROVED
Mayor
